descriptionChirho: Marker of position within a space, realm, state, or condition — the core spatial and metaphorical 'in' sense of the preposition.
Marker of position in the midst of a group or collective, indicating distribution or inclusion among persons or things.
Marker of accompaniment or association, indicating the company, manner, or attendant circumstance in which an action takes place.
Marker of the instrument, means, or agency by which an action is performed or a result is achieved.
Marker of position on a surface or at a specific point of contact, as distinct from being enclosed within a space.
